page.layout: Two cards on grey backing, one page of the scan: left, a resolution test target with line groups and a ruler; right, a colour checker chart. Handwritten shelf slip at top left, not transcribed.
page.notes: No book text on this scan. It shows a digitisation test target (resolution chart with a 0–60 mm scale, grey scale, and star targets) on the left and a colour reference chart on the right. The target's logo and copyright line belong to the digitiser and are left out. The handwritten shelf mark at top left is also left out.
